title: The Founders
summary: A Philadelphia militia in Extremis Malis that preys on local settlements and becomes a recipient of Mantis's enhanced weapons before the Division intervenes.

claims.text: Extremis Malis depicts the Founders as an armed Philadelphia group extracting resources from local survivor communities.
Mantis supplies the Founders with improved weapons, making the faction part of the Black Tusk-linked arms operation investigated by Caleb Dunne and Heather Ward.

paragraphs.text: The Founders show how the prequel's arms network works at local scale: an already coercive militia obtains better equipment and gains more leverage over nearby survivors.

verification.notes: Faction is limited to its role in the licensed graphic novel; no claim of a current in-game faction presence is made.
